proposals.title: Independent Board Chairman
proposals.topic_summary: Adopt a policy requiring separation of Chairman and CEO roles, with the Chairman preferably an Independent Director.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Humanitarian Risks Due to Climate Change Policies
proposals.topic_summary: Oversee an audit analyzing economic and humanitarian effects of JPM's climate transition policies on emerging nations and publish a report.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Indigenous Peoples' Rights Indicators
proposals.topic_summary: Provide a report on effectiveness of policies and performance indicators for respecting Indigenous Peoples' rights in corporate and project financing.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Proxy Voting Alignment
proposals.proponent: The Maryknoll Sisters of St. Dominic, Inc.
proposals.topic_summary: Review JPMAM's 2023 proxy voting record and policies on diversity and climate change and report results to shareholders.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Report on Due Diligence in Conflict-Affected and High-Risk Areas
proposals.proponent: Sisters of the Presentation of the Blessed Virgin Mary of Aberdeen, South Dakota
proposals.topic_summary: Commission an independent third-party report on JPMC's due diligence on human rights and material risks in conflict-affected and high-risk areas.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Shareholder Opportunity to Vote on Excessive Golden Parachutes
proposals.topic_summary: Adopt a policy requiring shareholder approval of NEO golden parachute packages exceeding 2.99 times base salary plus target short-term bonus.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Report on Respecting Workforce Civil Liberties
proposals.proponent: Bowyer Research Inc. on behalf of The Bahnsen Family Trust Dated July 14th 2003
proposals.topic_summary: Conduct an evaluation and issue a report on how policies impact employees based on religious or political views and related business risks.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.
